notes.title: Last update for 2024!
notes.content:
Hey everyone, as we round out the year I'm happy to add a couple fixes for GATE before the year closes out.

It was requested that an input field be added to the drawing tools, so users can explicitly set the width of lines and shapes. This allows users to be more consistent with their drawings if the size is changing throughout the session.  This is now available!  Have your own requests you'd like to see for GATE? Drop your feedback in our Discord or on the Steam community forums.

An issue with how fog is saved in certain scenarios has been addressed, and so fog should be more consistent in how it's persisted between sessions. If you have issues with loading fog from a previous save, please reach out!

Thanks for using GATE this year, here's hoping to some fun improvements in 2025! :)

notes.title: Full Hero Forge Support and Expanded Language Support
notes.content:
[h1]Full Hero Forge Support is here![/h1]
GATE has supported STL files for a while, but never had support for Hero Forge's digital miniatures. However, with the latest release that is no longer the case! You can now add your .unity3d files in the Artwork Manager to a new or existing collection and start using them!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40887298/2c01f15cda8643f5db6fc2dc5a2e765d2360c6dc.png[/img]

If you try and use your miniature and run into unexpected issues, reach out!

[h2]Expanded Language Support[/h2]
For those using languages other than English, the font in GATE has been updated to a unicode font that has greater support for other characters that were previously unable to be rendered in GATE. If you find there are still characters missing in your language of choice, please let us know!

[h3]And Finally[/h3]
In the new Notes feature, you can set the visibility as a DM. This allows you to prevent players from reading notes ahead of time. You'll find a toggle in the top left of a world note when you edit it.

notes.title: World Notes and Art Gallery
notes.content:
One feature most often requested is the ability to drop notes in the world, and the first iteration of that feature is here! DMs can now drop in notes via the context menu, or using the default shortcut 'N'.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40887298/9f411bba3a0fd7b045a7f7f04ffb588185ce9133.png[/img]

Notes show up in the world as a small icon, and clicking them allows you to edit the text associated with it. This box is only editable by the DM, for players it's read only. Eventually these notes will have a visibility that can be toggled by the DM, but it's currently always visible to all users connected to the session.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40887298/ffe6be298a436541b4808de7304f98c60e7f27f6.png[/img]

Additionally, DMs will notice a new option on the taskbar at the bottom of GATE. The Gallery allows you to upload images to a collection and share those images with players at the right time. So whether you want to set the tone for a new location, show what an enemy looks like with incredible detail, or show off anything else that might be useful, you'll find a way to do that now! Previously, you could only really show off images by loading them as maps, which wasn't always desirable.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40887298/c66fc49ba3dae579b753890adc0f821b0629506f.png[/img]

If you have any questions, concerns, or issues with the latest update, please reach out! Have fun!

notes.title: New In-Game Artwork Powered by PolyPizza
notes.content:
[h1]Greetings![/h1]

GATE has supported the use of 3D models for quite some time, but they've always had to be sourced from outside the game. Now, you can find models for your current situation without ever leaving the application.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40887298/9f3ccfb88cfbd7afa37bc2f883afa97038caac61.png[/img]

From the artwork manager, find the new Online Search feature and type in your search criteria! From there, you'll be able to select artwork from the results and add it to your existing collections. From there, add the artwork to your scenes as you've always done! Easy.

As this is a new feature with limited testing, it's being marked as a BETA feature. If you have any issues or bugs you run into, please let us know! Either on the [url=https://discord.gg/NKesD624yy]Discord[/url] or here on the Steam forums. Looking forward to what you do with it!

notes.title: Big Performance Gains
notes.content:
[h2]Moving on over to Amazon S3[/h2]
Hey everyone. If you've noticed over the past few days bad performance for your uploads, it's been addressed with this update.

Previously, token artwork and maps were stored on a webserver that held the files for the duration of a session to hand out to players.  While it served its purpose initially, performance began to get very poor, with long upload times for maps and 3D models.

Now, the file handling is being done on Amazon's servers, and as a result, upload times have never been better. Not only that, but there's no more worry about running out of room, so files are held onto longer than just a single session. What this means is that once you use a piece of token art or map, it'll be cached indefinitely. Next time you load a game, or reuse that piece of artwork, you won't have to upload a thing. This results in a much faster, smoother, and better experience for everyone.

If something isn't working as expected, let me know!

notes.title: Next Generation of GATE is Here
notes.content:
[h1]The Best GATE So Far[/h1]
After months of hard work, the latest version of GATE is here. There's so many changes and improvements, it really does feel like a whole new game. Let's break down some of the biggest changes.

[h2]Avatars[/h2]
When logging into GATE, players are now prompted to choose an avatar in addition to their color. This avatar is used alongside chat messages and displayed in-game to further differentiate players from one another.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40887298/8f532db4b80f7d53b23914393dd1be486c10dd08.png[/img]

[h2]Multiple Map Support[/h2]
GATE now supports unlimited maps being displayed at once. Move them, scale them, and rotate them with new gizmo support! Right-clicking a map shows new context options that allow a user to change the map layers, allowing maps to overlap in a way that best fits the situation.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40887298/c12c8114e51ed70c7a8ea7b3718d96b5f4588d5e.png[/img]

[h2]Props[/h2]
A new concept called Props has been introduced, allowing DMs to utilize 3D content to spice up a scene without that content having to be tied to a token. Now 3D objects can be freely dropped in and configured with the included gizmo tools.

[h2]Volumetric Fog[/h2]
Fog has been completely revamped. Instead of a flat 2D image, fog now actually looks like fog! It obscures drawings and maps, while giving tokens an air of mystery. Tokens can be hidden to be removed completely from players vision, and a future update will provide an option to have that happen automatically.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40887298/5050e0075bdaa11489091331492ea084f1e1454d.png[/img]

[h2]Drawing Tools[/h2]
No longer restricted to just a single width line, players now have access to a host of different options. Colors, size, and shapes are now available!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40887298/099a6a00ce82c337cd4151bc57f417f5cf27a91d.png[/img]

[h2]Streamlined Dice Roller[/h2]
Custom dice rolls are now integrated with the rolls that come out of the box! Each roll has an associated icon that lets players customize to their hearts content. With over 1000 icons to choose from, there should be something for everyone!

[h2]Intuitive Content Control[/h2]
The concept of the Workshop where you manage your collections has been removed. Now, to manage your 2D and 3D content, simply upload it during a session. No more swapping back and forth between the main menu and the main game to add artwork you need.

[h2]Major Performance Improvements[/h2]
A lot of loading is now done asynchronously, meaning less time required to get in and get started. DMs can get a session up and going in seconds. A drastic change compared to the previous performance metrics. Additionally, 3D content has seen a major performance gain as well, reducing stuttering as that content is pulled in.

[h2]And More![/h2]
A whole new UI layout, measuring tools, and more await! Be sure to let us know if you have any problems or suggestions after giving this new update a try. It's a big one, so bugs tend to crop up, and we'd like to crush them all.

Join the conversation on [url=https://discord.gg/WzUVMsAQVt]Discord[/url] or on the Steam forums!

notes.title: 3D support has finally arrived
notes.content:
This is the biggest update in quite some time! The obvious headline is that custom 3D content is now supported. Whether you've got a custom miniature you built in HeroForge, or you've got your eyes on one of the many creatures put out by the famous [url=https://www.shapeways.com/designer/mz4250/lists]mz4250[/url], you can now use them in GATE. 

To use these models, just visit the ingame Workshop and build a new Models collection. Models added to a collection need to be a .zip file containing a model, material (optional), and/or texture (optional). Models can be .stl, .obj, or .fbx!

More features related to these models will be added in the future.

In addition to the new 3D support, there's a number of smaller quality of life updates and bug fixes to make the overall experience much smoother.

[list]
[*] Tokens now have adjustable heights.
[*] Camera controls have been tweaks to support more flexibility.
[*] Camera speed can now be increased when holding a button (Shift by default).
[*] Session loading has been streamlined to avoid stuttering on session starts.
[*] Tokens now indicate when they are loading a 3D model or 2D token art.
[*] Notifications are now displayed when maps are being uploaded or downloaded.
[*] Favorite rolls have been reworked to allow for any number of preconfigured rolls.
[*] Dice rolling buttons now have tooltips to easily determine what dice will be rolled.
[*] DMs can now change the ground color.
[*] DMs can now change grid opacity.
[*] Health bars now change from green to red as tokens lose health.
[*] Map size/offset and grid visibility are now properly saved and loaded.
[/list]

notes.title: New Fog, Drawing Options, and Network Stability!
notes.content:
One of the oldest requested features on the to-do list was the option to change colors while drawing. Now, DMs have that ability! Players will still be tied to one color, so the DM can easily identify which drawing belongs to which player.

Fog has been completely reworked to accommodate more precise placement. In addition, adding or removing fog now has preview brushes to see what will be affected. No longer worry about accidently revealing a hidden room!

Large images weren't designed to be sent over the network using the library that powers GATE. Now, large images use a web server as a middleman to ensure that all maps and tokens make it to all connected clients. As a result of this change, maps can now be twice as large! (10MB)

Lastly, DMs can now save and load sessions! If you find your party needs to end their session in the middle of a complicated combat, you can now save everything and load it back up again later. Everything should just work.

If you have other requests you'd like to see in GATE, come find us in the Discord! We have a channel dedicated to feedback. Otherwise, send me a message on here or email me, I'd love to hear what you have to say!

[*] Fixed a bug that caused the 'View Fog as Player' and 'Snap to Grid' options to overlap in the UI as the host.
[/list]

notes.title: Patch Notes for 1/5/22
notes.content:
[h1]Complete Overhaul to the Dice Roller![/h1]
[list]
[*] The dice rolling parser has been completely replaced.
[*] Dice rolls now support complex logic, including exploding dice, rerolling, and keeping high/low values.
[*] A link to the reference guide has been added to the Favorite Rolls window. 
[/list]
[url=https://skizzerz.net/DiceRoller/Dice_Reference]View the reference guide to the new dice functionality here![/url]

notes.title: Patch Notes for 1/1/22
notes.content:
Happy New Year! To bring it in we have two feature requests that have been added.

[list]
[*] Drawings can now snap to grid when using a square grid. Support for other grid types may be added down the line.
[*] Tokens are now rotated at smaller increments for further precision. 
[/list]

notes.title: Patch Notes for 12/13/21
notes.content:
[h1]Enhancements[/h1]
[list]
[*] Images can now be shared by the DM and viewed by players. This is useful for showing off clues the players come across, or showing off a high resolution picture of an NPC.
[/list]

[h1]Fixes[/h1]
[list]
[*] Drawings are now drawn on a 2D flat plane and no longer rotate to face the camera.
[*] Refreshing available skins no longer doubles entries in the filter dropdown.
[*] Fixed Forcecage SRD content.
[*] Fixed Prismatic Wall SRD content.
[/list]

notes.title: Patch Notes for 11/30/21
notes.content:
[h1]Fixes[/h1]
[list]
[*] Tokens now maintain their aspect ratio when converted into 3D meshes. This means that token art will no longer be squashed and stretched to fit into a square space.
[*] Token art previews in the browser are no longer stretched to fit a square aspect ratio.
[/list]

notes.title: Patch Notes for 11/26/21
notes.content:
[h1]Fixes[/h1]
[list]
[*] The alpha threshold used when creating 3D meshes from token art has been tweaked to work better with high resolution images.
[*] Tokens in the workshop can now be as large as 500 KB.
[/list]

notes.title: Patch Notes for 11/17/21
notes.content:
[h1]Fixes[/h1]
[list]
[*]  Multiselect now works as expected regardless of orientation.
[*]  Token options are now hidden automatically when more than one token is selected.
[*]  The Reset Fog and Hide Fog hotkeys are now no longer triggered when typing.
[/list]

notes.title: Patch Notes for 11/15/21
notes.content:
[h1]Enhancements
[/h1]
[list]
[*] DMs can now view fog from the players perspective.
[*] Hotkeys added to add fog and remove fog.
[*] Demo users can now host private sessions to try out DM functionality in a limited environment.
[/list]

[h1]Fixes[/h1]
[list]
[*] Changes have been made to prevent player input from affecting the game when it's no longer in focus.
[*] Rotating the camera is now smoother on the start of the rotation.
[*] Fixed a bug that caused the hide UI function to cause weird behavior.
[*] The feedback form now properly wraps text.
[/list]

notes.title: Fog and Keybinding
notes.content:
[h1]Fog Now Available[/h1]
A lot of DMs like to hide content from their players until their players discover it. Now DMs can blanket the ground with fog, obscuring maps, drawings, and tokens. As players venture through the dungeon, the DM can remove fog, revealing what's beneath.

The DM is able to see through the fog like so:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40887298/d01d4206893c6667a63b6cda5b1d353458820ee9.png[/img]

However the players will not be able to see through it:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40887298/c1badf5d44cc7888092293d2d0d3ffd54ab7788e.png[/img]

[h1]Keybinding[/h1]
Every modern game lets players rebind their controls, and now GATE does too! While in a session, keybinds can now be set from the Settings menu! If you want to move the camera with the arrow keys, now you can!

notes.title: Patch Notes for 11/05/21
notes.content:
[h1]Fixes[/h1]
[list]
[*] The Toggle Grid functionality is now fixed.
[*] The Toggle Grid functionality is now handled by the DM, with the visibility syncing down to players.
[/list]

notes.title: More Patch Notes for 11/03/21
notes.content:
[h1]Enhancements[/h1]
[list]
[*] Maps and layers are now optimized before being sent to players, resulting in up to 80% smaller file sizes. This should increase network performance.
[/list]

notes.title: Patch Notes for 11/03/21
notes.content:
[h1]Enhancements[/h1]
[list]
[*] DMs can now change the grid color under Environment options.
[/list]

[h1]Fixes[/h1]
[list]
[*] Network messages have been optimized to hopefully reduce the amount of times that a map doesn't sync to connected players.
[*] The grid should now be more visible when viewed on top of a map.
[/list]

notes.title: Patch Notes for 11/01/21
notes.content:
[h1]Enhancements[/h1]
[list]
[*] The feedback option now includes a field for an email address so I can contact those who use it as a place to report problems.
[*] Maps now maintain their scale and offset when reloading them later in the session.
[/list]
[h1]Fixes[/h1]
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug that allowed players to draw even if the DM disabled player drawing.
[*] Fixed a bug that broke map functionality when using images outside of a collection.
[*] The DM menu has been slightly extended to remove the need for a scroll bar.
[/list]

notes.title: Patch Notes for 10/24/21
notes.content:
[h1]Enhancements[/h1]
[olist]
[*] Maps now have easier to use sizes. Each unit represents one square on the grid.
[*] Maps can now be offset from their origin to align better with the grid.
[*] DM's can now prevent players from drawing.
[/olist]

[h1]Fixes[/h1]
[olist]
[*] Hexes on the hex grid have been reduced in size. They now measure 5ft in diameter. Tokens have been scaled down 25% to compensate.
[/olist]

notes.title: Patch Notes for 10/20/21
notes.content:
[h1]Enhancements[/h1]
[list]
[*] Maps can now have layers. These layers are useful if you want to overlay a secret room or reveal rooms as players explore. For best results, ensure your layers are the same resolution as your base image.
[*] Grid types can now be changed by the DM. In addition to a standard square grid, you can now use a hex grid or an offset-square grid.
[/list]

[h1]In Progress[/h1]
[list]
[*] A way to offset the position of maps
[/list]

Have suggestions on features you think would improve GATE? Please let us know via the Feedback option in game or stop by our Discord!

notes.title: Dev Play Session
notes.content: Come watch Rogmar, Fule, and Ryal adventure through the Forgotten Realms as they play their D&D session in GATE.  The developer of GATE will be their DM, and available to answer any of your questions!

notes.title: Patch Notes for 10/14/21
notes.content:
A big thanks to those of you who have given feedback over the last couple weeks!

[h1]Enhancements[/h1]
[list]
[*] Maps should now be loaded around 50% faster than before.
[*] Map and token art is now cached to improve network performance. Loading maps a second time should be almost instantaneous.
[*] The technology handling line generation has been completely replaced, so your drawings should look smoother than ever before.
[*] Clicking the compass in the bottom right of the screen now resets your camera orientation.
[*] Maps can have their sizes more finely tuned to more accurately match the grid spacing in game.
[/list]

notes.title: Patch Notes for 9/28/21
notes.content:
[h1]Enhancements[/h1]
Tokens now have a small arrow, indicating their current direction. This is useful if you're playing a system where character facing is important.

notes.title: Patch Notes for 8/15/21
notes.content:
[h2]Enhancements[/h2]
Browsing your available tokens and maps has never been easier.  New dropdown lists let you select which collections you'd like to view.

[h2]Fixes[/h2]
Maps were not being properly synced between players due to buffer restraints. Allocations have been increased, and maps should now properly sync between players.

notes.title: Patch Notes for 8/05/21
notes.content:
A big thank you to the players who have had the opportunity to upload their own token collections to the Workshop!  Thanks to you, it was discovered that there was a problem with the UI that occurred when subscribed to more than four collections.  As such, the following fixes have been made.

[olist]
[*] Subscriptions can now properly be viewed in the Workshop when more than four have been subscribed to.
[*] Collections now have a bigger area to display descriptions, allowing more text to be seen than before.
[*] Tips have been added to the main screen, showing some shortcut keys until a full control configuration page is added.
[/olist]
Thanks again to all the players making content for the game, hopefully GATE is working well for your campaigns!

notes.title: Patch Notes for 7/31/21
notes.content:
Thanks to some feedback from early adopters, some quality of life updates have been added:
[olist]
[*] Collections can now be deleted.
[*] Using the arrow keys, you can cycle through previous chat entries.
[*] The spellbook and monsters windows can now be dragged around.
[/olist]

As always, if you have any suggestions for further changes, let us know!

notes.title: Patch Notes for 7/30/21
notes.content: It's launch day, which means that problems are going to come up last minute. Luckily this was a small one. There was a problem with the UI in regards to picking colors for your username, but that's now been solved! I hope everything else runs smoothly, and if you run into problems, please let us know on Discord, the Steam forums, or via the feedback option in game.
